'''Pokémon Adventures: Blue Returns''' is the twenty-second monthly issue released by [[VIZ Media]] of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Mato]]. It contains chapters eight, nine, and ten of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. The chapters originally released in this book were later rereleased as part of {{PAV|4}}. As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.

==Important events==
* {{adv|Yellow}}, aided by [[Brock]], [[Misty]], [[Erika]] and {{adv|Blaine}}, defeats {{tc|Super Nerd}} {{adv|Miles}}, and [[Pika]] is freed.
* Misty, Brock, Erika, and Blaine head off to find {{adv|Red}}.
* Yellow meets {{adv|Blue}} and goes off with him to train.
* Yellow is given an [[Omny|Omanyte]] from Misty and a {{p|Graveler}} from Brock.
* Blue is revealed to have caught a {{p|Lapras}}.
